feature: CCNA Fundamentals: DHCP server and relay
scenarioChecks: Server enabled without a relay cannot lease addresses across the router
Published IOS helper commands and all IOS/Windows verification commands execute successfully
Clients receive distinct addresses outside the excluded range with the correct mask, gateway and DNS options
Received ACKs identify the client-facing relay address, and matching server bindings are required for lease credit
A static address cannot pass a lease task; changed options and released leases invalidate it
Wrong-interface helper, disabled DHCP, wrong pool subnet and missing server return gateway each prevent fresh leases; correction restores traffic
Routed ICMP and DNS resolution use delivered simulated traffic
Saved and completed labs reacquire leases after reload and power cycles instead of trusting imported runtime data
Imported DHCP predicates and actions reject malformed address, prefix, range, duration and executable values
